message:
Saved the reviewed document: [Open document](<{destination}>).

{status}Document checks passed. Content review: {reviewer}.
decision_note: Version 2 receipts may carry one reviewed sentence copied verbatim from the document and the anchor of its section. Receipts without message_version use the version 1 message unchanged.
successor_note: A version 2 receipt may carry one reviewed next-document suggestion bound to the bytes of the sources it relies on. Message verification fails once any of those sources changes.
